title: OVERSEER CHASES TOP DAMAGE
why: His g-24 answer: Whoever hurt it most. The host tracks damage and shares the chosen seat. Watch: the higher-damage partner holds the Overseer all fight; watch that the other player does not feel left out and that the target does not flip back and forth.
now: In a party raid the Overseer pursues the standing player who dealt the most damage. Ties use the nearest player. Both windows use the host target.
